Title: General availability of Azure Monitor for Key Vault and Azure Cache for Redis

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for Key Vault and Azure Monitor for Azure Cache for Redis are now generally available. These insights built on the Azure Monitor Workbooks platform provide a unified view of resources performance and health, using telemetry automatically captured by the platform.

These insights work out of the box and are available from the Azure Monitor blade and the respective Azure resource blades in the Azure portal, providing both resource centric and at scale views, allowing deeper drill downs. You can also fully customize these workbooks to align with your requirements and save as your own custom workbooks.
